thread:
paul (release): quick flag 6:156 - small but steady QPS drop (~5%) on embeddings eu-west1. Triage points to a KV eviction heuristic regression. Requesting expedited hotfix in next 10m window.

nora (sre): ack. can we do a tiny canary (5%) first? traffic is spiky but safer. If skipping canary, we need ENG+SRE+oncall approvals. Need image sha + smoke & rollback criteria.

diego (eng): image: gcr.redwood/embed:hotfix-6998@sha256:abc123de. Patch reverts aggressive evict and adds metric evict_guard. Staging perf + smoke green.

paul (release): smoke checklist: 1) /health 200 2) p50 within baseline +8ms 3) evict_guard trending down. rollback: sustained error-rate +2% for 90s OR p95 > baseline +150ms for 2m -> pin previous sha256:ff11ee22 and shift traffic back.

jen (oncall): oncall ack; will monitor logs/alerts.

nora (sre): prefer canary=5% for 2m then 50% for 1m then full. that meets safety and keeps approvals minimal. +1 SRE.

diego (eng): +1 ENG. unit/e2e passed.

paul (release): deploying with canary plan. release note stub: "hotfix: mitigate KV eviction loop affecting embeddings in eu-west1; monitoring enabled; CS notified."

releasebot: Deploy request accepted. Plan: canary=5% (2m) -> 50% (1m) -> 100%. Requirements: oncall ack + one approver satisfied.

deploy-bot: Starting rollout embed -> sha256:abc123de; rollout id rl-6998882222-1; canary 5% for 2m.

jen (oncall): watching. temp alert silence for noise enabled.

deploy-bot: Canary 00:30s: minor 429 blip at +12s but below auto-hold threshold. p50 stable, evict_guard down.

nora (sre): canary passed 2m. advancing to 50% for 1m.

deploy-bot: Advancing to 50% -> 1m window started.

jen (oncall): 50% looks clean. no sustained errors.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete -> success rl-6998882222-1.

paul (release): thanks all. follow-up: please open PR to add canary guard for 429 spike >0.5% to auto-hold canaries. tagging eng-triage.

diego (eng): will open PR today.

nora (sre): monitors in watch mode 24h. closing thread unless we see regressions. :white_check_mark:
